verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a strong one-line headline and its CTA grouped under the copy, but the Lumen & Fig logo is shrunk to an illegible speck. The 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow sits below the subcopy, out of reading order, and there is dead space top-right and bottom-right. B has a bigger headline, but the brand logo and a tiny eyebrow are pushed to the bottom under the body copy, which flips the reading order. The CTA floats alone at the far right, cut off from its copy by a large empty gap, and the bottle's dropper touches the top edge, so the layout feels scattered.
